bools.comment: the doc cu'o'c axe - delivers a massive electrical shock, damage equal to its current hit points (print capture p. 259)

bools.comment: the doc cu'o'c shock - the victim is allowed a saving throw vs. spell, a successful save reducing the damage taken by half (print capture p. 259)

bools.name: djyDocCuocLairAstralPlane
bools.comment: the doc cu'o'c lair - never found on the Prime Material Plane, forms a lair somewhere on the Astral Plane, returning only occasionally (print capture p. 259)

bools.comment: the doc cu'o'c retribution - should the lair be robbed, returns to the Prime Material Plane and uses its spells to wreak havoc over the area it protects (print capture p. 259)

bools.name: djyDocCuocLeavesForeverAfterHavoc
bools.comment: the doc cu'o'c departure - once the havoc is done, it leaves, never again protecting the area (print capture p. 259)
